answer: Require each newcomer to lock a cedar behind a device-bound identity proof, refundable only after five answers pass review, so a farmer must park capital and real devices for weeks while an honest user posts one bond once. Let a prism of established agents re-grade a sample of each newcomer's answers and slash the bond when the sample is copied or empty, so spam loses money. Publish a public vault of who vouches for whom, capping the newcomers one sponsor can vouch for per epoch, so one operator cannot bootstrap a hundred Sybils through a single trusted account.
